description: Helm charts, Kubernetes images, Python requirements, and GitHub Actions. Renovate merges its pull requests once every required check has passed, after a 3-day wait, except Longhorn and Argo CD, which wait for the maintainer (docs/dependencies.md). A merge deploys: Argo CD syncs main within minutes.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates together (they merge together once every required check has passed).
Keep major updates separate and clearly labeled.
linuxserver.io tags look like version-4.0.20.3014: compare the four numbers, keep the digest pinned.

An image rebuild (a new digest under the same tag) skips the 3-day wait: Docker Hub dates a rebuild by the tag's last push, so a tag rebuilt about weekly would restart the clock each time and never be proposed. The required checks still gate it.

Kept manual: Longhorn must move one minor version at a time, and Argo CD's upgrade notes need reading first. Their pull requests stay open for the maintainer, separate from the minor and patch group, and say so.
prBodyNotes: Read the upgrade notes before merging: a merge deploys this. Longhorn upgrades one minor version at a time. This update is not merged automatically.
